title: Inside the 73-Star: a 37-Star and a 37-Hexagon
summary: The two 73-point star figures again: on the left a gold outline marks the 37 inner points that form a smaller six-pointed star ('37-Star'); on the right a red outline marks 37 inner points that form a hexagon ('37-Hexagon').

numbers.note: points inside the gold star outline (37-Star) and inside the red hexagon outline (37-Hexagon)
total points in each large star figure

pictures.description: Left: a 73-point star of small blue Stars of David with a gold six-pointed star outline drawn inside; the 37 points within it are coloured gold. Labelled '37-Star' in gold.
Right: a 73-point star of small blue Stars of David with a red hexagon outline drawn inside; the 37 points within it are coloured red. Labelled '37-Hexagon' in red.
